title: One writer, many readers
summary: A live terminal session has exactly one mutation owner at a time while multiple observers may inspect immutable snapshots. Mutation additionally requires current-generation authority; stale control is refused rather than queued.
invariants: No queued stale keystrokes after generation changes.
Controller transfer is revoke/release -> no controller -> grant at current generation.

provenance.claim: Supports this Terminal Machine/TN5250 continuity article.
